noveltyJustification: Extracted the rewrite contract from the installed filter-repo's own help (callbacks incl. the tag-message trap, fresh-clone/prune behavior, commit-map format, replace-refs modes), measured signed commits/annotated tags/notes/replace state, and rejected notes/replace on evidence.
keyQuestions: What do git filter-repo --message-callback/--commit-callback preserve and lose, how are tags rewritten, what does the commit map look like, and are git notes/git replace viable non-rewrite alternatives?
answeredQuestions: What do git filter-repo --message-callback/--commit-callback preserve and lose, how are tags rewritten, what does the commit map look like, and are git notes/git replace viable non-rewrite alternatives?
ruledOut: git notes as the identifier carrier (not searched by --grep, not published, not rendered by GitHub)
git replace as the identifier carrier (local-only, not fetched/pushed by default, not understood by GitHub)

label: filter-repo aborts on non-fresh clones; --force needed for reruns; default run prunes reflogs and old objects; fetches origin by default
--message-callback processes tag messages too; guard with --commit-callback for id stamping
Signatures and extended headers are stripped; signed tags become annotated; 11 signed commits (B), 98 annotated tags in this repo
--dry-run disables message rewriting — cannot rehearse id stamping; full rehearsal on throwaway mirror required
commit-map: 'old'/'new' header, all commits listed, null new = removed, cumulative chaining across runs; id plan joins by old SHA
replace-refs default update-no-add; publication requires manual push+fetch opt-in; GitHub does not serve replace objects
notes: 0 today; refs/notes not fetched by default; --grep does not search notes; GitHub does not render them
Only message text is indexed by both git log and GitHub; notes/replace sit beside commits, not in them
Rollback = restore refs from an untouched bare backup; pruned objects are unrecoverable without it
Verdict: rewrite with filter-repo on a mirror is required; notes/replace rejected as carriers
